We had an amazing time cruising with friends on the tiki boat! Robbie was an excellent captain—fun, friendly, and focused on making sure everyone had a safe and enjoyable experience. The boat was equipped with great music, a paddle board, a floating lily pad, and even a bathroom on board, which made the trip even more comfortable. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a memorable day on the water with friends/family!

I had such a fun time on this boat ride! The staff was friendly, professional, and made the experience even more enjoyable. The ride was smooth and the views were absolutely gorgeous! It was a memorable experience from start to finish with many smiles and laughs along the way. Definitely worth it and I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great time on the water!

Robbie was an exquisite captain. Everything was a great. He was friendly from the start, welcoming, explained all details regarding the trip. We set sail and a fun time. Would definitely recommend this trip for anyone interested in booking. Also, my first time on a boat, a bit nervous but Robbie made us comfortable.
I would 100% recommend this tour to anyone! The tour guide was super cool!! We took the tour from 7-9pm… perfect time and a great sunset!!
Carson was the captain and did a wonderful.job cruising my family and I around the bay!! Highly recommend for the 7 to 9 p.m. session!!
